children: CapForce appointed John Tan Honjian as CEO, reassigned Christian-Laurent Benoit Bonte to President, Business Development, and made other management and board changes.
Stepped down as COO to serve on the Board; director agreement
Elijah Tan Theng Wei appointed COO
Leads AEI Capital Group and has investment banking, private equity, M&A and legal experience.
Previously COO at Astra Enterprise, partner at Sora Ventures, and held roles at Coins.ph, Binance and Goldman Sachs.
Stepped down as COO to serve on the Board

$13,000 monthly salary, $13,000 bonus, discretionary performance bonus of two to 24 months’ base salary, 2,353 RSUs vesting November 30, 2026, and potential business-development incentive compensation.
One-year consulting term, renewable for successive one-year periods; $10,000 monthly fee and annual RSU grant valued at $150,000 on grant date.
$3,000 monthly director fee and eligibility for equity compensation under company incentive programs.
$108,000 annual base salary, eligibility for a discretionary performance bonus after one full year, and stock grant valued at $120,000 on grant date.
